versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Text Encoding Detector.
- Detects text file encoding, including UTF-8, GBK, GB2312, Latin-1, and UTF-16 LE/BE.
- Automatically recognizes BOM (Byte Order Mark) markers.
- Pure Python implementation with no external dependencies.
- Reports both encoding type and file size.
- Useful for fixing garbled files, batch conversion, and verifying encodings before processing.
